subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model-cost estimates remain USD-only, or should OpenClaw define a supported non-USD currency contract for configured provider/model pricing and cost display?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the request changes public config and accounting semantics across schema, status output, Control UI, persisted USD-named fields, telemetry, and provider-reported billing boundaries; automation should not choose that product contract.

options.title: Design one currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO-code validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave models.providers.*.models[].cost as USD estimates and keep non-USD balances in provider-reported usage/billing surfaces.

options.title: Add display-only override
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol override while documenting that stored totals, telemetry, and aggregation remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Design one currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO-code validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest usage-cost and provider-billing history that this product decision must coordinate with.
